title: Shop Supplies Refund Rate on Estimate Overage Credits — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
The shop supplies refund on a Service Accounts and Repair Orders estimate overage follows the paid repair order's fees and the account's tier. The paid repair order is the repair order of the latest payment received on the account.

| Shop supplies fee on the paid repair order | Account tier | The overage is increased by |
|---|---|---|
| Stands on it | Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum | the tier's shop supplies share, as a share of the overage |
| Stands on it | Any other tier | 0.5 of the tier's shop supplies share, as a share of the overage |
| None | Any | nothing; there is no supplies refund |

The tier's shop supplies share is the one in the shop fee schedule.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- An overage of 40.00 on a Gold-type account whose tier share is 6% and whose paid repair order carries a shop supplies fee is increased by 2.40.
- The same overage on another tier whose share is 8% is increased by 0.5 of 8%, that is 4%, or 1.60.
- With no shop supplies fee on the paid repair order the overage is not increased.
